$comment: Managed by hstack-kit (react adapter). Add or replace checks in .hstack-kit/checks/local.json, not here. setup and the ready command below detect pnpm or yarn from their lockfile; npm is the default.
setup: if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then corepack enable && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then corepack enable && yarn install --immutable; else npm ci; fi

checks.name: verification smoke (Playwright)
checks.run: npx playwright install chromium && node .cursor/skills/verify-react-counter/control.mjs smoke --if-tailored
